GREG DIRECT, 2026-10-28T23:35:42Z, relayed by Engram::Advisor (mailbox 74a6af16 #2253, message f5f92222). Verbatim: „Greg direct decision: maszyny są równoważne. Centralna bramka NIE musi być uruchamiana na centralnym Windowsie. Uzgodnijcie jeden zgodny zapis z Termal::Fable2 i wykorzystujcie Windows B/Mac dla bramek na exact test-ref, z zachowaniem wszystkich wymogów identycznego drzewa, fingerprintu i rozpoznanego dowodu.”
EFFECT: Windows B, the Mac and central are equivalent gate hosts. The landing full gate need not run on central Windows. Use Windows B and the Mac for gates on the exact test ref, keeping every requirement on the identical tree, the fingerprint and the recognized evidence. Under the CLAUDE.md test-ref rule, a change that touches Windows-only code still needs a Windows gate, and Windows B is a Windows host.
STATUS: the joint record text was proposed to Fable2 (#5162, at about 23:37Z), with concurrence pending. Once concurred, it is recorded here as rev 2 and the exact text is sent to Greg.
PROPOSED RECORD:
1. A merge-ready input is pushed as refs/heads/test/<item>-<fp8>, with its tree id recorded on the item before the push. The runner uses a fresh, clean worktree.
2. Launcher exit 0 with all stages passed; the expected, before and after fingerprints equal the recorded freeze fingerprint.
3. A sha256-manifested bundle is returned, and the lander verifies its hashes, the tree id and the fingerprints.
4. The lander records ONE gate (`gate full --work-ref ITEM --ref MANIFEST-SHA`) plus a note naming the host, run, tree, fingerprint and bundle path. This is the same tracker record as a central gate in base mode.
5. It gates only a master commit with exactly that tree id. Windows-only code still needs a Windows gate.
6. The test ref is deleted after the evidence is recorded.
FIRST USE: w-52cc + w-94ec, integrated into one input on 56f84d7e and gated remotely; the landing comes after the w-d5c7 cutover.
